limitations: Vendor-documented native smoke commands were run; neither upstream's complete test suite was run.
The filesystem permit/deny commands are additional synthetic controls through the real CLI; they are not an upstream test suite.
No network-policy, TLS, SOCKS, IPv6, DNS-rebinding, hostile-workload, resource-limit, VM-boundary or escape qualification is claimed.
Worktrunk smoke uses an owned one-commit repository with hooks disabled and no remote; crash recovery, dirty removal, shell integration, LLM operations and user repositories remain outside it.
Native F2 invocations prove use in this measured window only; continued operational integration and usage remain adjudication gaps.
Scratch paths and disposable Git object identifiers are substituted before publication and hashing. No digest of unpublished raw output is retained.
Historical verdicts, gate policy, run manifest, host binaries and defaults remain unchanged.
